active_learning_addon.acquisition: greedy maximum of the sum over the five gated outputs of the latent posterior variance (working space) among the unselected pool designs; ties by case id
active_learning_addon.initial_subset_rule: the first initial_count designs of the seed-1 random order (shared by the AL run and the seed-1 random run)

authority.prior_surrogate_protocol_lineage: modern/experiments/l0_surrogate_v2 (role partition, forbidden active inputs, single-use assessment loader), l0_surrogate_v5 (method-selection / final-calibration / assessment roles with group disjointness), l0_surrogate_v7 (group-valid interval ranks), l0_surrogate_v9/POSTHOC_AUDIT.md (tautology rejection)
authority.template_campaigns: modern/experiments/mdo_l0_campaign_v1 (experiment_runtime lifecycle, shakedown gate, CPU BoTorch code contract) and modern/experiments/orbit_wall_loss_geometry_screening_v1 (dataset producer, label access records)

baselines.best_baseline_rule: for the 2x gate the best baseline is the one with the LOWEST raw pooled-P RMSE on the assessment role itself (conservative against the surrogate)
baselines.global-mean: fit-role mean of each output (P units)
baselines.knn-3: unweighted mean of the 3 nearest fit-role designs in the fit-role unit box (Euclidean; ties by case id)
baselines.ridge: ridge regression on the unit-box inputs plus intercept (P units); penalty chosen on the method-selection role from [0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1.0] by the same mean-RMSE criterion

calibration.method: cft_revival.surrogates.VarianceCalibrator.fit on the 50 standardised residuals (five gated outputs x ten calibration designs) in the selected candidate's working space, where the standardising variance is latent posterior variance + prediction-time observation noise; the resulting single variance_scale multiplies the total predictive variance of every output (including p_reflect_pooled)
calibration.rank_rule: order statistic ceil((n + 1) * 0.9) - 1 of the sorted |residual| / sd (n = 50 -> the 46th of 50)

definitions.botorch-icm-logit: BoTorch MultiTaskGP (intrinsic coregionalisation: Matern-5/2 ARD data kernel from get_covar_module_with_dim_scaled_prior times a rank-2 PositiveIndexKernel over the four cells, per-task ConstantMean, one Standardize, train_Yvar fixed noise) jointly over the four cell logits; p_wall_pooled and p_reflect_pooled from botorch-stgp-logit single-task models
definitions.botorch-stgp-direct: the same SingleTaskGP on the direct proportion
definitions.botorch-stgp-logit: BoTorch SingleTaskGP with train_Yvar (FixedNoiseGaussianLikelihood), covar_module = get_covar_module_with_dim_scaled_prior(ard_num_dims=11, use_rbf_kernel=False) (Matern-5/2 ARD with the dimension-scaled LogNormal length-scale prior, no outputscale), ConstantMean, Standardize outcome transform, fit_gpytorch_mll (scipy L-BFGS-B), torch float64 on cpu with 8 threads, torch.manual_seed(0) before each fit; on the empirical logit, one model per output
definitions.pkg-exactgp-direct: the same ExactGP on the direct proportion with Laplace-smoothed binomial variance, one model per output
definitions.pkg-exactgp-logit: cft_revival.surrogates.ExactGP (ARD Matern-5/2, deterministic bounded grid hyperparameter selection, fixed heteroscedastic observation variance) on the empirical logit, one model per output

determinism.rule: after the final model is written, every fitted component is refitted from scratch in-process on the same fit rows; working-space latent means and variances at the assessment and extrapolation inputs must agree within 1e-9 (absolute) and hyperparameters within 1e-9 relative; bit-exactness is recorded

candidates.package_multi_output_note: cft_revival.surrogates offers IndependentMultiOutputGP only (independent outputs); it has no ICM/LMC kernel, so the coregionalised variant uses BoTorch and is declared as such
candidates.selection_criterion: mean over the five gated outputs of the raw P-unit RMSE on the method-selection role; lowest wins; ties broken by declared order

forbidden_readings: that P(wall) predicted here is the wall-loss probability of a real thruster or of a self-consistent plasma
that the surrogate is accurate outside the interpolation scope (the extrapolation assessment is reported, its gate may fail)
that passing the interpolation gates validates the orbit or field models
that the ARD length-scales or permutation importances are physical sensitivities rather than sensitivities of the screening dataset
claim_boundary.prior_surrogate_failures_disclosure: Nineteen earlier surrogate campaigns (l0_surrogate v1-v9, l1a_field_surrogate v1-v10) failed their predeclared gates or were invalidated; the audited causes were lack of physically varying training data, pooled-row conformal ranks that were not group-valid, and a tautological target (l0_surrogate v9: the target was an algebraic function of the inputs). This campaign uses the first wall-loss-vs-geometry dataset, a held-out partition frozen before any fit, single-use assessment, and a target produced by orbit integration (not by any algebraic function of the inputs).
claim_boundary.statement: Surrogate of a SCREENING dataset; not physical-orbit evidence; not a performance model. The targets are orbit-integration outcome counts on L1a screening fields; the surrogate reproduces those counts' probabilities within a declared accuracy inside a declared interpolation scope. Nothing here validates the orbit model, the field model, the mirror picture or any thruster figure of merit.
usable_as: a design-dependent wall-loss input for an MDO v2 that carries the SCREENING label and the interpolation scope
a sensitivity report of which geometry-v1.1 parameters drive the screening wall-loss probability
a template for surrogate campaigns on physically varying data (held-out discipline, known-noise GP, predeclared gates)

classification_statement: A learned surrogate (design parameters -> collisionless test-particle wall-loss probability per axial cell) of the SCREENING_L1A_FIELD_TEST_PARTICLE_WALL_LOSS dataset produced by modern/experiments/orbit_wall_loss_geometry_screening_v1. Every prediction inherits that label: it is a surrogate of a SCREENING dataset on L1a linear-vacuum fields (not P2-qualified), never physical-orbit evidence, never a plasma or thruster-performance model. The campaign tests whether a Gaussian-process surrogate can interpolate the screening dataset to a predeclared accuracy with calibrated uncertainty; it does not test physics.

code_contract.source_hash_line_endings: LF (fails closed on any CR byte)

dataset.git_binding_rule: the dataset and manifest working-tree bytes must hash to dataset_file_sha256 / manifest_file_sha256, their Git blob ids at screening_result_commit must equal dataset_git_blob / manifest_git_blob, the manifest entry for the dataset must carry the same byte hash, and screening_result_commit must be an ancestor of HEAD
dataset.label_rule: P(wall) = termination_counts.wall_hit / trial_count of the accepted-2N case (pooled, 512 launches) and per_cell[accepted-2N][cell].wall_hit.successes / trials (128 launches per cell); P(reflect) = termination_counts.reflected / trial_count; the dataset's stored probabilities must equal these ratios exactly

stage_order: development: fit-role fits of every candidate, method-selection scoring, selection, calibration, predictor export, determinism replay, sensitivity, AL add-on
assessment: single-use assessment and extrapolation labels, metrics, gates

gates.acceptance: all binding gates pass -> accepted_surrogate; otherwise the campaign is recorded as rejected with every metric published

beats_best_baseline_2x.statement: raw pooled-P RMSE of the best baseline on the assessment role >= 2.0 x the surrogate's raw pooled-P RMSE

code_contract.statement: source hash, package versions and python minor version equal the preregistered authority

coverage_90.statement: empirical coverage of the calibrated 90 % observation intervals over the 80 assessment predictions (five gated outputs x 16 designs) lies in [0.80, 0.97]

dataset_binding.statement: dataset.git_binding_rule holds and the dataset's stored probabilities equal integer count ratios

determinism_replay.statement: candidates.determinism rule holds for the selected model

interpolation_rmse_cells.statement: floor-corrected RMSE over the 64 assessment cell predictions (four cells x 16 designs) <= 0.05; the raw RMSE is reported beside it because the 128-launch cell labels carry a binomial floor of about 0.035

interpolation_rmse_pooled.statement: raw RMSE of p_wall_pooled over the 16 assessment designs <= 0.05

no_tautology.statement: the three no-tautology checks of outputs.no_tautology_statement pass

partition_frozen_single_use.statement: the recomputed partition equals partitions.json and the frozen authority hash; role sets are disjoint with the declared counts; the label access records show assessment and extrapolation labels first read in the assessment stage after the predictor artifact was written

predictor_contract_replay.statement: the dependency-light predictor (predictor.py on predictor.json) reproduces the fitted model's working-space latent mean and variance at every assessment and extrapolation input within 1e-9

active_learning_addon.statement: uncertainty-sampling selection from the fit-role pool with the dependency-free ExactGP-logit model vs seeded random subsets, scored on the method-selection role at budgets 20/30/40; reported, never gated

beats_best_baseline_2x_cells.statement: best-baseline raw cell RMSE >= 2.0 x surrogate raw cell RMSE

extrapolation_coverage_90.statement: coverage of the 50 extrapolation intervals in [0.80, 0.97]

extrapolation_rmse_cells.statement: floor-corrected RMSE over the 40 extrapolation cell predictions <= 0.10

extrapolation_rmse_pooled.statement: raw RMSE of p_wall_pooled over the 10 extrapolation designs <= 0.10 (may fail; reported honestly)

reflect_output.statement: p_reflect_pooled RMSE and coverage on both scopes are reported without a gate

inputs.degeneracy_check: every input must take at least 8 distinct values across the 96 designs and the 96 input tuples must be distinct; fails closed otherwise
inputs.known_discontinuities: stage_count = min(5, 3 + int(3 * stage_count_selector)) (steps at 1/3 and 2/3), first_polarity = +1 if first_polarity_selector < 0.5 else -1 (step at 0.5), exit_length = 0 when chamber_length * exit_length_fraction < the sweep's exit_minimum_length_m; the surrogate sees the continuous selectors, so these steps are a declared source of irreducible model error
inputs.normalisation: affine unit box fitted on the FIT role only (minimum / span per input, cft_revival.surrogates.InputNormalizer semantics); assessment and extrapolation inputs may fall outside [0, 1]
inputs.source: design_values of each dataset row = the eleven declared variables of the L1a geometry sweep v2 (geometry v1.1 PPM stack parameterisation); the sweep's build_case maps them to the realised geometry

known_noise.direct_transform_noise_variance: p_tilde (1 - p_tilde) / n with p_tilde = (s + 1) / (n + 2) (Laplace-smoothed so that s = 0 or s = n never yields zero noise)
known_noise.logit_transform: empirical logit y = log((s + 0.5) / (n - s + 0.5)) with noise variance 1 / (s + 0.5) + 1 / (n - s + 0.5) (Haldane-Anscombe); the inverse map is the logistic function applied to the latent mean and to the interval endpoints
known_noise.model: binomial: each label is a sample proportion s/n with n = trials
known_noise.prediction_time_observation_noise: added unscaled to the calibrated latent variance: logit scope 1 / (n p_hat (1 - p_hat)) with p_hat = clip(sigmoid(m), 0.5 / (n + 1), (n + 0.5) / (n + 1)); direct scope p_hat (1 - p_hat) / n with p_hat = clip(m, 1 / (n + 2), (n + 1) / (n + 2)); the observation interval is the interval an independent n-launch replicate should fall in

outputs.no_tautology_statement: Each target is a count of orbit terminations produced by orbit_mc v1.7 relativistic-Boris integration in an L1a re-solved field of the design; there is no algebraic expression of the eleven inputs that yields the count (the map passes through a PCG field solve and an event-driven ODE integration with 512 launches). The campaign verifies (a) the stored probabilities equal integer count ratios, (b) no target column equals an affine function of any single input column, (c) a ridge regression on the inputs does not reproduce the fit-role targets to better than the binomial floor.
outputs.noise_floor_rule: the binomial floor of an assessment set is sqrt(mean over its labels of p (1 - p) / n) with the observed p; floor-corrected RMSE = sqrt(max(RMSE^2 - floor^2, 0)); both raw and floor-corrected RMSE are recorded for every output and scope
outputs.pooled_identity: p_wall_pooled equals the mean of the four cell probabilities exactly (equal trials per cell); it is fitted as its own output and the identity is verified on the data, not exploited by the model

extrapolation_cluster.rule: the ceil(0.10 * 96) = 10 designs with the largest geometry.chamber_length_m (ties broken by case_id) form the EXTRAPOLATION hold-out; they take part in no other role and are never used for fitting, selection or calibration

partition.frozen_record: partitions.json is written by prepare (case ids per role, sha256 of the sorted id list per role) and its semantic hash is bound in authorities.json; execute and the prebundle stage recompute the partition from the protocol and refuse on any difference
partition.label_access_records: every extraction of labels from the dataset is preceded by an ExperimentRuntime before_expensive(kind='label') access record naming the role, so the bundle proves the assessment and extrapolation labels were first read in the assessment stage
partition.rng: random.Random(int.from_bytes(sha256(namespace + ':' + str(seed) + ':' + stratum)[:8], 'big')).shuffle(sorted case ids of the stratum); roles are then assigned in order fit, method-selection, calibration, assessment with the declared counts

role_semantics.assessment: SINGLE-USE: opened once in the assessment stage after the model, the selection and the calibration are frozen and written; scores the interpolation-scope gates
role_semantics.calibration: labels used once to fit the single variance scale of the 90 % intervals; never used for fitting or selection
role_semantics.extrapolation: SINGLE-USE: opened once in the assessment stage; scores the extrapolation-scope report
role_semantics.fit: the only labels any model may be fitted on
role_semantics.method-selection: labels used once to choose among the declared candidates and the ridge penalty; never used for fitting the final model

artifacts: artifacts/training-table.json (inputs and working-space targets per role, without assessment/extrapolation labels until assessment)
artifacts/candidates.json (per-candidate fit diagnostics and method-selection scores)
artifacts/assessment.json (per-design predictions, truths, intervals for both scopes)

sensitivity.ard_length_scales: per output, in fit-role unit-box coordinates; for the ICM the shared data-kernel length-scales; a large length-scale means the output is insensitive to that input

permutation_importance.metric: increase of the raw P-unit RMSE on the fit role when one input column is permuted across the fit designs, averaged over repeats; per output and averaged over the five gated outputs

prepare_requires: protocol_semantic_sha256 equals the current protocol hash
source_sha256 and package versions equal the current code contract
shakedown partition differs from the evidentiary partition (different role assignment)
runtime terminal state accepted_result and bundle validated
all candidates fitted, a selection recorded, predictor replay passed
shakedown.purpose: Exercise the complete production path (dataset binding, partition, every candidate, baselines, selection, calibration, predictor export, determinism replay, sensitivity, AL add-on, assessment metrics, gates, publication through the shared ExperimentRuntime into a temporary root, validate_bundle) on the REAL dataset with a DIFFERENT partition seed namespace before the preregistration freeze. Gates are informational. Because the dataset is finite and fixed, the shakedown necessarily reads every label; the evidentiary information barrier is procedural: protocol, gates and candidates are frozen by hash before prepare, the shakedown record is bound into the authorities, and any protocol edit after the shakedown invalidates it.
